Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog: Fixed Review timeline HP becoming misaligned during rapid multi-hit attacks. Fixed delayed snapshots causing old HP or shield values to reappear. Improved shield tracking without adding misleading zero-damage rows. Hits with missing result data now show clear before-and-after HP bars. Healing rows now appear only when the HP increase can be confirmed.
